text:
alex: Heads-up — putting together a small spec for runtime kernel-selection telemetry. We need a compact "reason"/debug payload so we can trace why picks changed (arch-aware picks, seq-length thresholds, KV cache state, batching heuristics). Saw a perf blip with seq=768 yesterday; want to capture that.
sophia: I captured the trace for the 768 case. runtime log currently says: `pick=matmul_32 fallback=pack_kern_v2 rule=seq>=512`. Not enough context to tell why it chose matmul. We should add structured reasons, not just freeform.
miguel: +1. Proposed minimal schema sent downstream: `kernel_name`, `kernel_id`, `pick_reason` (enum), `pick_score` (float), `seq_len`, `batch_size`, `kv_hit_rate`, `arch_tag`. Keep it tiny.
tara: please mention privacy/PII — don't dump model inputs or prompt text. Telemetry should only have rates/hashes. Also retention policy: store reasons for 30d by default.
ryan: for debugging we also want an opt-in verbose flag that appends a short decision trace: a few lines explaining tie-breakers. e.g. `arch_match -> cpu_offload_check -> batch_fit`. Something human readable but short.
perf-bot: profile snippet for request 1859012240:
```
pick: matmul_32
candidate_scores: {pack_kern_v2: 0.72, matmul_32: 0.75}
seq_len: 768
batch_size: 4
kv_cache_state: partial_miss
gpu_ms: 12.8
cpu_ms: 3.1
```

alex: That profile is great. Two immediate asks: (1) canonicalize `pick_reason` values (we can enumerate), (2) a debug env var to enable more verbose mode for a subset of hosts.
sophia: Suggested enum list: `ARCH_MATCH`, `SEQ_THRESHOLD`, `BATCH_OVERFLOW`, `KV_MISS_FALLBACK`, `QUANT_PROFILE`, `HEURISTIC_TIEBREAK`. Each pick can include multiple reasons ordered by precedence.
miguel: We should also log a compact `pick_bitmap` integer for quick aggregation (bit flags for the same reasons). Helps rollups without shipping strings.
tara: Fine if we do bitmap, but still include the human enum in verbose mode. And ensure telemetry scrubber runs before export.
ryan: Debug env proposal: `RW_RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel:pick_reasons,verbose_trace` or per-service via config `runtime.debug.kernel=true` + `runtime.telemetry.reasons=on` so we can enable for 5% of traffic.
perf-bot: small suggestion — include `selected_kernel_fingerprint` (4byte hex) so different builds/patches can be correlated to kernel binaries. Example: `kf=0x4a3c`.
sophia: Also important: capture `kv_hit_rate` at shard-level. In many of our regressions the kernel pick flips when KV hit rate drops below ~0.6 causing more memory copies and matmul becomes better. So add `kv_hit_rate` (0-1 float) and `kv_state` enum (`hot`, `partial`, `cold`).
alex: Agree. UX for logs: telemetry line per request should be under 200 bytes. keep keys short. Example compact JSON we can emit: {k:"matmul_32",id:"4a3c",r:["ARCH_MATCH","KV_MISS"],b:4,s:768,kvr:0.42,ps:0.75}.
miguel: For perf/regression triage, we need to sample full verbose traces on N requests with highest latency delta (delta compared to baseline). We can wire that to the existing sampling framework.
tara: Add ACL for verbose traces — only SRE/ENG_RUNTIME and authorized SEs.
ryan: Implementation notes: where to produce the reason? The pick happens in kernel_selector.cc. We should augment the pick API to return `PickExplanation { reasons: vector<string>, score }` and attach to request trace if debug enabled. Otherwise compress into a small telemetry blob.
sophia: I'll add the env flags and wire the pick_reason enum in the next PR. Draft of the env usage in README:
```
# enable compact telemetry reasons for 10% of traffic
export RW_RUNTIME_TELEMETRY_SAMPLING=0.1
export RW_RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel:reasons
# enable verbose traces for one instance
export RW_RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel:verbose_traces
```

alex: QA checklist: (1) ensure last_message_ts matches emitted traces for a request, (2) test seq thresholds 128/512/1024 across ampere/v100/rdc, (3) ensure no prompt leakage, (4) end-to-end latency regression test with sampling on.
miguel: I'll run a small sweep tomorrow and post a CSV of aggregated counts + example traces.
sophia: I'll open the RFC PR with enum and the compact JSON format. Link to PR once up.
tara: If anyone needs access to the verbose traces, ping me and I'll grant.
alex: thanks all — this should make root-cause for kernel flips much faster. :thumbsup:
